title: Tilapia Burger Patties
description: This recipe combines fresh tilapia with vegetables and panko bread crumbs to form tilapia burger patties that are pan-fried to perfection on the stovetop.
ingredients: 5 (4 ounce) fillets tilapia, cut into cubes
3 tablespoons olive oil, divided, or as needed
2 bunches green onions, thinly sliced, with green tops separated from white bottoms
1 pinch onion powder, or to taste
1 pinch garlic powder, or to taste
1 pinch red pepper flakes, or to taste
1 pinch ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Place tilapia in the bowl of a food processor; pulse until finely chopped.

Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add celery, green onion white parts, bell pepper, and garlic; cook until vegetables start to brown, 5 to 7 minutes. Add green onion green parts and parsley; cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Cool, about 10 minutes.

Combine vegetable mixture and tilapia. Season with salt, onion powder, garlic powder, red pepper flakes, and black pepper; mix with your hands until well combined. Add bread crumbs and egg; mix until thoroughly combined. Shape into 12 burger-sized patties.
Heat remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil on a griddle over medium to medium-high heat. Cook patties, in batches as needed, until nicely browned, 3 to 5 minutes per side.
